scope: mask-only independent review; no generated H&E was available or used

decisions.reason: This is the sole candidate passing all frozen hard gates. The significant immune transition is spatially localized and coherent, with complete contained nuclei and preserved protected structures despite a pronounced density increase.
decisions.tissue_geometry: The 79,013-pixel joint change forms connected authorized stroma-to-immune regions; its 74,347-pixel tissue component preserves adjacent tumor and non-target compartments.
decisions.nucleus_layout: The 114 class-2 nuclei are complete, non-overlapping and contained. Source-relative area-p95, count, NND and Ripley ratios are 0.659, 1.846, 0.766 and 1.637.
decisions.coupling: Added immune nuclei remain inside authorized changed tissue; quota, seam, compatibility, distribution and density checks pass with score 0.891.
decisions.preserved_conditions: Protected nuclei, prohibited regions and support-exterior instances remain unchanged without partial-instance, overlap or containment violations.
decisions.limitations: The target population is substantially smaller, more numerous, denser and more clustered than source. These values pass the pre-frozen significant-target envelope but require explicit reporting; mask-only evidence does not establish generated-H&E quality or clinical validity.
decisions.verdict: Approve candidate 03 as the single mask-condition handoff, retaining the high-density limitation.
